info.title: Health Chain Supply Platform
info.description: Multi-tenant health supply chain backend for India with role-based access control, geographic scoping, JWT authentication, and audit logging.

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT pair
post.description:
Authenticate email and password.
Issues 15-minute access token and 7-day database-hashed refresh token.
Records audit log event for all attempts.

post.summary: Refresh expired access token with valid refresh token
post.description:
Validate cryptographic refresh token against hashed database store.
Issues new access token if valid and unrevoked.

post.summary: Revoke refresh token and terminate session
post.description:
Revoke the specified refresh token in the database.
Prevents any future access token renewals.

get.summary: Get authenticated user's profile and active permissions
get.description:
Retrieve currently authenticated user's profile, role assignments,
geographic scope boundaries, and consolidated permission set.

patch.description:
Update own profile attributes (full_name and phone only).
Email, roles, geographic scope, and is_active cannot be modified here.
Requires 'update_own_profile' permission.

post.description:
Change current user's password after validating current password and strength.
Requires 'change_own_password' permission.

RBAC verification endpoint.
Only PHC Approvers and Super Admins have permission 'approve_phc_request'.
PHC Operators receive 403 Forbidden and audit_logs are populated.

get.summary: Test endpoint verifying multi-tenant geographic isolation for district data
get.description:
Geographic multi-tenancy verification endpoint.
A district user from Ramgarh can never access Ranchi district data (403 Forbidden).
Super Admin bypasses all scope filtering (200 OK).

post.description: Create a new user with RBAC role assignments. Requires 'create_user' permission.

get.summary: Get single user detail
get.description: Retrieve details for a single user by ID. Requires 'view_users' permission.

patch.description:
Update user's name, email, phone, geographic scope, or roles.
Password cannot be updated here. Requires 'update_user' permission.

post.description:
Soft-deactivate a user account and revoke all active refresh tokens.
Admins cannot deactivate their own accounts. Requires 'deactivate_user' permission.
Reactivate a previously deactivated user account. Requires 'activate_user' permission.

Generates a secure temporary password, marks password change as required,
revokes existing refresh tokens, and returns the temporary password once.
Requires 'reset_user_password' permission.
